page_title: BOL 1-0 INT | Bologna v Inter 20/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Andrea Colombo has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90+7' Santiago Castro (Bologna) receives a yellow card.
90+6' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+4' 1 - 0 GOOOOOAL! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds space in the box from the lofted pass and lands the perfect scissor-kick goal. G.O.A.T? Probably not, but it’s 1:0.
90+3' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+2' Juan Miranda (Bologna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' One of the Inter players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) for Jens Odgaard.
88' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Matteo Darmian will be replaced by Yann Bisseck (Inter).
88' That will be all from Lautaro Martinez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nikola Moro (Bologna) will replace Michel Aebischer.

87' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
86' Juan Miranda (Bologna) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.

84' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
83' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a decent header which rattles the left post!
81' Having seen unsporting behavior, Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Joaquin Correa (Inter) is the recipient.
81' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
77' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Dan Ndoye and he is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
77' Thijs Dallinga will be replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
76' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will deliver the corner kick.
74' Matteo Darmian (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Andrea Colombo no option but to blow his whistle. Bologna get a free kick.
73' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. Inter are awarded the free kick.
71' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
71' Matteo Darmian (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.
70' Here is a change. Benjamin Dominguez is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
69' The game has come to an end for Joaquin Correa. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
68' Nicolo Barella (Inter) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Bologna are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
67' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Federico Dimarco (Inter).
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) is replacing Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
64' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Federico Dimarco (Inter) replaces Alessandro Bastoni.
64' Emil Holm (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
63' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Andrea Colombo ignores the protests.
60' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
58' The referee gives a yellow card to Dan Ndoye (Bologna).
56' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Vincenzo Italiano, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
56' Nicolo Barella (Inter) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrea Colombo saw the whole situation. Bologna earn a free kick.

55' Nice move, nice attempt! Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.

53' Joaquin Correa (Inter) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
51' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Andrea Colombo had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Bologna.
50' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Bologna for a penalty. Play continues.
49' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

48' The game is interrupted. Emil Holm (Bologna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Inter.
48' Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) commits a foul and Andrea Colombo immediately signals a free kick. Inter are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) commits a foul during an attacking move. There is a free kick near the sideline to Inter.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.

44' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Andrea Colombo with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Bologna in a dangerous position.
43' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
42' Remo Freuler (Bologna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Inter.
41' A pass by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
39' Caution goes to Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).
37' The referee blows his whistle after Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. Bologna have a free kick.
36' Andrea Colombo blows for a foul after Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Bologna have been awarded a free kick.
35' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

34' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
34' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
33' Nicolo Barella (Inter) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
33' Inter earn a corner.
32' Carlos Augusto (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Good work from Inter as they win a corner.
29' The ball is out of play. Bologna win a corner kick.
26' A neat pass is well received by Michel Aebischer (Bologna), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
23' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is adjudged offside.
18' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
16' Great teamplay by Bologna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
13' Carlos Augusto (Inter) picks up an injury.
9' Remo Freuler (Bologna) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
8' Rough tackle by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

7' It looks like Nicolo Barella (Inter) saw red with that tackle. Andrea Colombo won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Bologna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
6' A pass from Remo Freuler (Bologna) is intercepted by Yann Sommer and the move breaks down.
5' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) is caught offside!
4' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Carlos Augusto (Inter), but it's just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
3' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
3' Andrea Colombo interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
